The only change in docs/provider/cli-reference.md is documentation for the benchmark scheduler-prefill row (head lines 524 and 527-544). It adds a `--prefill-fixed-prompt` flag and a note on rotating seed tokens by `iteration * 17`. The patch excerpt is truncated, so the remainder of the new paragraph is not visible. The supplied base units cover lines 1-846 of the file and do not show the edited region's head text, so I inspected the patch excerpt rather than head line numbers.

The visible change is a benchmark-harness flag description only. It touches no protocol, authorization, attestation, key handling, cache storage, logout or other trust-boundary behavior, and it makes no claim about security properties.

The benchmark flag does not appear to touch the prefix-cache threat T-041. The surrounding docs say benchmark modes run with the cache off or do not measure checkpoint writes. I saw no claim that this flag changes cache-salt scoping, the HMAC lookup tags, the TTL or the SEC-035 acceptance. Deterministic or fixed prompts in a benchmark harness would not alter the production gate in PrefixCachePolicy, but I cannot confirm that because the corresponding source change (BenchmarkCommand.swift and BenchmarkCommand+Sweep.swift) was not supplied.

Open question: if the flag implementation changes cache behavior or writes persistent artifacts, that would need review in the code files. I do not treat this as a finding.
